content: अभिमानिन् {%a.%} .²1 Possessed of self-respect; <ls>Ki. 1. 31</ls>; <ls>K. 212</ls>. .²2 Having a high opinion of oneself, proud, arrogant, conceited. .²3 Regarding all objects as referring to oneʼs own self; अभिमानिव्यपदेशस्तु विशेषानुगतिभ्याम् <ls>Br. Sūt. 2. 1. 5</ls>. .²4 Fancying, pretending, or regarding oneself to be; नरेन्द्र˚ <ls>Dk. 51</ls>; <ls>K. 194</ls>. {%m.%} A form of Agni.
